text:
sam: Heads up — kicking off a small v2 cutover for the API today at 19:30 UTC (12:30 PT). This is a staged slice (backfill-3) to validate client compatibility and perf. Deploybot will run the window. Please hold pinned mobile clients.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled roll window created by sam. Plan: warmup 5m -> 40% traffic 10m -> 100% if green. Runbook: /ops/runbooks/v2-cutover. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall.
alex: Can we keep the mobile SDK pinned (mobile team requested hold)? They still send legacy header-case.
maria: +1 on pinning mobile. Also please add tenant `acme-pay` to the skiplist — they reported a schema mismatch yesterday.
jen: What's the rollback criteria? Need clear thresholds for operations to revert immediately.
sam: Rollback if any of the following sustained for 5m: 95th latency > 400ms, error rate (5xx) increase > 1% absolute, or mobile client 4xx spike > 2x baseline. Also any customer-facing alerts from support.
deploybot: prober summary (pre-roll): prober-backfill-3: 5m rolling OK. prober-latency=98ms, 200-rate stable. No 5xx seen in the last 10m.
ryan: Note for release notes: v2 enforces stricter schema on `messages` field (will reject extra top-level keys). I'll write a short migration snippet and put examples in docs. Link: https://docs.internal/redwood/v2-migration#messages
sam: Added release note draft. Will include a code snippet for the mobile SDK.
oncall-lisa: I'll watch dashboards from the oncall console. Ping me @oncall-lisa if thresholds hit and I will escalate.
alex: Adding acme-pay to skiplist: `deploybot add-skip acme-pay`
deploybot: command accepted — acme-pay added to skiplist. Mobile SDK clients pinned: tenant-scope pinned -> header-case shim still enabled.
maria: Also queue a post-cutover smoke check at +30m (basic flow + token auth check).
sam: Good call. Scheduling follow-up check. Starting warmup in 2m. Ops-eyes on :eyes:
jen: @sam please note we should flip the schema-gating flag slower if we see client validation errors — don't auto-escalate to full traffic.
sam: Agreed. We'll hold at 40% and manual gate to proceed.
ryan: Quick reminder for support team: add a short troubleshooting snippet to the ticket template about header-case and schema mismatch.
oncall-lisa: Got it. I'll coordinate with support to pre-populate common responses.
alex: all set from infra side, watching deploybot logs.
sam: Go-time in 30s. Team, eyes please.
deploybot: roll window started: warmup phase. live-log: `curl https://deploybot/api/rolls/7250012345/logs`
jen: :thumbsup:
ryan: Will validate sample traffic and post any anomalies here.
sam: Thanks. Will update thread after 10m evaluation.
